meaning_short: 父母期望子女出人頭地、成為有成就的人。

panels.title: 解釋
panels.scene: A chibi dad in a tiny home office, dressed as a cheering coach with a whistle, standing behind his 7-year-old chibi son who is furiously writing calligraphy with a giant brush. The dad's eyes sparkle with stars, sweat drops flying, exaggerated shouting pose with mouth wide open. Bookshelves overflowing with trophies and textbooks. Comic-book action lines radiating from the kid.
panels.caption: 爸媽恨不得小孩馬上變天才!

panels.title: 句型
panels.scene: A chibi mom grabbing her elementary-school son's shoulders at the school gate, leaning in intensely. The kid's backpack is overflowing with cram-school books and piano sheets. Speech bubble showing 補習班, 鋼琴, 奧數, 英語. The kid has a tired, blank expression with spiral marks above the head. Other parents in background doing the same.
panels.caption: 媽媽望子成龍,週末排了八個才藝班!

panels.title: 同義詞
panels.scene: Three chibi parent figures with thought bubbles showing thumbs-up and stars. Icon labels in bright colors: 望女成鳳, 望子成才, 寄予厚望. Comic-book sparkle effects.
panels.caption: 望女成鳳 / 望子成才 / 寄予厚望

panels.title: 反義詞
panels.scene: Two chibi parents relaxing on a couch eating popcorn while their kid plays freely in a yard with butterflies. Speech bubble showing 放輕鬆, 快樂就好. Soft pastel colors, no stress lines. Contrast with the previous stressful panels.
panels.caption: 放任自流 / 順其自然

title_banner: 成語四格漫畫 ─ 望子成龍
